msg: Hello! We just booked a 5 dive package with you for April 13th. On the morning of the 13th we will be checking out of our Airbnb, in order to stay on the Rosario islands that night. So we will have our luggage which consists of two large hiking backpacks (no suitcases). Will there be somewhere we can store these during the dives?
reply:
Hi! 🪸 I'm *Coral* from *Diving Planet* — we dive year-round in the Rosario Islands, departing from Cartagena or right from the islands. 🌊

Yes, there are lockers at our island base where you can leave your belongings while you dive. Since your bags are large hiking backpacks, I can’t confirm whether they’ll fit in the lockers.

There is always availability: we operate every day, including public holidays, except December 25 and January 1; if sea conditions are not safe, the trip is rescheduled.

Would you like me to connect you with a team advisor to check?
